title: Maintaining Older Tailwind Projects knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Maintaining Older Tailwind Projects?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
migration depends on the old version, new build integration and browser support requirements
questions.answer_key: migration depends on the old version, new build integration and browser support requirements
questions.explanation: Maintaining Older Tailwind Projects is best understood through the syllabus topics: Reading version-specific documentation, Understanding legacy class patterns, Pinning versions when required. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with maintaining older tailwind projects?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
work in a branch, follow the official upgrade guide and compare representative pages
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: work in a branch, follow the official upgrade guide and compare representative pages
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Reading version-specific documentation, Understanding legacy class patterns, Pinning versions when required, Evaluating compatibility requirements.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying maintaining older tailwind projects?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
do not mix v3 and v4 directives or configurations without a migration plan
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: do not mix v3 and v4 directives or configurations without a migration plan
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
